name: WF1 Personal Publish — HITL (INACTIVE — DO NOT AUTO-POST)

parameters.content:
## WF1 personal-profile publish

Inactive on import. No schedule and no Webhook trigger.

A run starts only from Manual Trigger. It stops at Wait for Gideon. LinkedIn is called only after a POST to that execution's resume URL with decision=yes, approved_by=gideon, a timezone-aware timestamp, and text_sha256 equal to Hash Draft.

Author is the person URN urn:li:person:<id>. Replace urn:li:person:REPLACE_PERSON_ID in Set Draft Post with the id from GET /v2/userinfo field sub (LINKEDIN_PERSON_ID).

Credential name: LinkedIn CleantechHUB n8n (78cn54). Scope w_member_social (openid and profile supply the member id). Rebind the placeholder id in the n8n UI. Do not paste secrets into this workflow.

parameters.jsonOutput:
{
  "post_text": "[DRAFT] Replace with the exact copy Gideon will approve. Human-in-the-loop required.",
  "visibility": "PUBLIC",
  "reshare_parent": "",
  "person_urn": "urn:li:person:REPLACE_PERSON_ID",
  "publish_target": "personal_profile"
}

nodes.name: Set Draft Post
nodes.notes: Draft in. Edit post_text before Execute. person_urn is urn:li:person:<id>. Leave reshare_parent empty for a text post, or set a urn:li:share: / urn:li:ugcPost: URN.

nodes.name: Hash Draft
nodes.notes: SHA-256 of the exact UTF-8 post_text. Same rule as scripts/cm/page-publish.py. Author stays the person URN.

nodes.name: Approval Request
nodes.notes: Out-of-band request. This node does not email, Slack, or post.

nodes.name: Wait for Gideon
nodes.notes: Pauses this execution only. Resume URL is single-use. Expected JSON: {"decision":"yes","approved_by":"gideon","timestamp":"2026-10-30T16:00:00+00:00","text_sha256":"<Hash Draft>"}. No time-based resume.

nodes.name: Build Personal Post
nodes.notes: Author is the person URN. Text post omits reshareContext. Reshare sets reshareContext.parent only. Do not send reshareContext.root.

nodes.name: LinkedIn Create Personal Post
nodes.notes: Uses the OAuth2 credential named LinkedIn CleantechHUB n8n (78cn54). Scope w_member_social. Author is the person URN urn:li:person:<id>. No bearer token in this node.

nodes.name: Log Published
nodes.notes: Ledger-shaped log. Does not store the access token.

nodes.name: Log Not Approved
nodes.notes: False branch. Does not call LinkedIn.
